assets.exactPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Redraw ONLY the complete orange-brown wooden sword that lies diagonally across the frame from upper left to lower right. Preserve the observed long blunt bokken silhouette, shallow curvature, broad wooden upper section with the two black calligraphic characters 蛇魂 exactly as seen, warm orange lacquer/wood, the narrow dark-brown central gripping area and the rounded narrow lower-right wooden tip. Keep the same perspective and diagonal, no new side or rear view. Raiden's fingers obscure a short central grip: continue only the simplest consistent wooden grip through that short gap, do not invent a guard, circuitry or ornament. Detailed game-render surface faithful to the low-resolution 2013 screenshot; do not redesign as a metal katana. Entire sword inside frame with generous transparent margins. Real alpha transparency. Remove all people, hands, pavement, background, detached particles, the blue aura, copyright caption and UI; keep only the two observed black characters that are printed on the weapon itself. No pedestal, ground shadow, repeated objects, montage or labels.

Preserve the hood's pointed center seam and folds, exposed eyes without goggles, the cream cloth mask, original angular PS2 model proportions and muted olive palette. Do not invent legs, feet, hidden pouches, helmet, modern armor, shoulder insignia, patches or a full-body pose. Render crisply while preserving the PS2 design, not a modern photoreal remake.
